nodes.name: Map AI Output And Pack Skills

parameters.content:
## 1️⃣ Load Bank, Template & Config
Loads your experience bank, CV template, and CV Generation Config (threshold, owner name). Runs once per trigger.

**Before running:** replace
[experience-bank.md](https://github.com/iamFeri/cv-tailoring-pipeline/blob/master/experience-bank/experience-bank.md)
and the
[CV template](https://github.com/iamFeri/cv-tailoring-pipeline/blob/master/templates/CV2_placeholders.tex)
with your own data, and set `cv_owner_name` below.
Details: [TEACHABLE_GUIDE.md §1](https://github.com/iamFeri/cv-tailoring-pipeline/blob/master/TEACHABLE_GUIDE.md#1-load-bank-template--config).

## 2️⃣ Search LinkedIn for Job Postings
Builds a paginated LinkedIn search from your target titles/filters, scrapes job links, and dedupes them.

nodes.name: Section: Search LinkedIn for Job Postings

parameters.content:
## 🔁 Per-Job Loop
Loops through job links one at a time, looping back after each job (success, error, or skip) until all are done.

## 3️⃣ Fetch Job & Skip Duplicates
Scrapes the job page; skips straight back to the loop if this job's link is already in the tracker Sheet.

## 4️⃣ AI Scoring & Content Selection
Gemini scores the fit and picks bullets/skills in one call. Jobs below the threshold are skipped.

**Works for any field** — the prompt auto-adapts to your bank, no rewrite needed.
To sharpen it for your field, edit `SIGNAL_CATEGORIES`
in the `Format Bank For Prompt` node below.
Details: [TEACHABLE_GUIDE.md §5](https://github.com/iamFeri/cv-tailoring-pipeline/blob/master/TEACHABLE_GUIDE.md#5-ai-scoring--content-selection).

## ⚠️ Gemini Retry / Backoff
Retries a failed Gemini call with a 35s wait, up to 3 times, before logging the failure and moving on.

## 5️⃣ Build & Compile Tailored CV
Packs the AI's picks into the LaTeX template and compiles to PDF via latex-api.

## 6️⃣ Deliver Result
Success: Telegram + Drive + tracker Sheet. Compile failure: error message with the compiler log (below).

## 📊 Run Summary
Fires once after all jobs finish; dumps the full array of per-job results collected along the way.

## 🚀 START HERE
Every credential, file/sheet ID, and prompt example below is a placeholder — this canvas will not run until you fill them in.

**Setup steps:**
[README.md](https://github.com/iamFeri/cv-tailoring-pipeline/blob/master/README.md#getting-started)

**Every node explained:**
[TEACHABLE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/iamFeri/cv-tailoring-pipeline/blob/master/TEACHABLE_GUIDE.md)

**Works for any profession**, not just tech/sales:
1. Your own data in
[experience-bank.md](https://github.com/iamFeri/cv-tailoring-pipeline/blob/master/experience-bank/experience-bank.md)
and the
[CV template](https://github.com/iamFeri/cv-tailoring-pipeline/blob/master/templates/CV2_placeholders.tex).
2. Your own credentials and file/sheet IDs on every node below.

The AI prompt (🔴 *AI Scoring* section) adapts to your bank automatically — see that section's note for the one optional tweak.
